newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Boxmore acquires Belgian firm Viprint BVBA.
newsitem.headline: Boxmore acquires Belgian firm Viprint BVBA.

text.p: Boxmore International Plc said on Wednesday that it had acquired 100 percent of Belgian-based ViPrint BVBA for an initial consideration of around 275,000 sterling.
An additional deferred consideration of up to a maximum of 190,000 pounds may also become payable, Boxmore said in a statement.
The consideration will be satisfied out of existing resources.

ViPrint will become a subsidiary of Boxmore Healthcare Packaging Europe NV and will be involved in the supply of cartons, labels, leaflets and plastic containers to European customers involved in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.

"Boxmore are very pleased to have concluded this acquisition which represents part of the ongoing strategy to service the growth in demand from our pharmaceutical and healthcare customers throughout Europe," deputy chairman Sam Moore said.
